Audience: a stressed procurement buyer on launch weekend, and a hackathon jury (Lio, an AI procurement startup) watching a 3-minute demo on a projector. Read-only on the repo; write only under /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/brand/.

Critique the current proposal: /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/brand/ask-soony-identity.html (read the HTML; render it with headless Chrome if useful: `cd /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony && uv run --quiet --with playwright python script.py` using `p.chromium.launch(channel="chrome")`, file:// URL; screenshots into the brand folder). 2. Build ONE alternative direction as a self-contained HTML page at /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/brand/ask-soony-identity-b.html with exactly the same sections and the same real example content as the current page (hero/mark, colour meanings, type, header sentence + countdown, launch timeline with the "Too late" gutter and 20,000 game cards on Tue 24 Nov, the decision hero "SAP 48,000 due Sat 21 Nov ≠ document 20,000 arrive Tue 24 Nov" with the highlighted Korean shipping advice excerpt, list rows incl. Visual identity · proposal

Every number points to the line it came from.

Ask Soony reads what suppliers send, checks it against SAP and asks a person only when it matters. The identity follows that idea: calm surfaces, one highlighter yellow for "found in the source", and colour that always means the same thing.

Ask Soony
Colour

Colour is a statement, never decoration

Each colour has one meaning across the whole product. Red is rationed: it only appears where something misses the trucks or stops a line, so it keeps its weight on a projector.

stop
Misses the trucksPast the launch line, a line stops, the late quantity. Nothing else is red.
warn
Short but recoverableAmber means "act today and it holds".
action
Something you can doButtons and links only. Never used for status.
auto
Done by a routineAnything an agent did on its own, so it reads differently from your own decisions.
mark
Found in the sourceThe highlighter: evidence, citations, highlighted words in PDFs and scans.
silent
No newsShipments that stopped updating. Grey, hollow, never green.

Neutrals lean slightly blue (ink #0e1726, panel #f1f4f8) to sit with the action blue. Both themes are defined; the light theme is the default because projectors wash out dark screens.

Type

Two faces, one display size

Inter for everything you read; Inter Tight only for the numbers that decide something. Codes and file names stay in mono and stay out of headlines.

Display 60 / 80020,000
Title 28 / 700Trucks in 6 h 12 min

One sentence instead of eight numbers

The top of the screen answers the only question that matters on Sunday, in words, with the countdown beside it.

/* ---------- app chrome ---------- */

/* status band */

/* timeline band (inside 1440 screen, so positions are fixed percentages of the track)
   hours: Sat 06-22 = 16, night compressed to 2.5, Sun 06-20 = 14, after the trucks = 6. Total 38.5 */
.tl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 104px minmax(0, 1fr); padding: 0 24px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line) }

.lane { position: relative }

.night { position: absolute; top: 22px; bottom: -4px; left: 41.56%; width: 6.49%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line) 0 1px, transparent 1px 6px); opacity: .9 }

.nowline span { position: absolute; top: -16px; left: -14px; font: 600 10.5px var(--mono); color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-tint); padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 3px }
.tick { position: absolute; top: 4px; height: 20px; border-left: 1.5px solid var(--ink) }

.lane-note.stop { color: var(--stop); font-weight: 600 }
.late-card { position: absolute; top: 28px; left: 87%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap }
.late-card i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--stop); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--stop-line) }
.late-card b { color: var(--stop); font-weight: 600 }
.late-card span { color: var(--ink-2) }

/* body */
.body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 404px minmax(0, 1fr); height: 724px }

.row .due { font: 500 12px var(--mono); color: var(--ink-2); white-space: nowrap; margin-top: 2px }

.stack { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 5px; padding: 1px 6px 1px 5px; background: var(--app) }
.by { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--routine); font-weight: 500 }
.by.voice { color: var(--ink-3) }
.row.done h4 { color: var(--ink-2) }
.row .rico { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--routine) }
.row .rico.voice { color: var(--ink-3) }

/* detail */
.detail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 272px; min-height: 0; background: var(--app) }
.main { padding: 0 32px 24px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px }
.dbar { height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); margin: 0 -32px; padding: 0 32px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-3) }
.dbar .sep { color: var(--ink-4) }

.dtitle { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.02em; font-weight: 600; max-width: 30ch; margin-top: 4px }

.lang { font: 600 10.5px var(--mono); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 4px; color: var(--ink-2); line-height: 16px }
.docview .t { padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 12.5px/1.85 var(--mono); color: var(--ink-2) }
.hl { background: var(--mark); color: var(--on-mark); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--mark-line); border-radius: 2px; padding: 1px 3px; font-weight: 600 }
.cite-line { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); line-height: 1.6 }

.rec { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 4px 16px; background: var(--app); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm) }
.rec .k { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 500 }
.rec h4 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.01em }

.rec .cost { grid-row: 1 / span 3; grid-column: 2; text-align: right; align-self: center }

.alt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2) }

.actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center }
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 7px; font: 500 13.5px var(--font); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--app); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); white-space: nowrap }
.btn.primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(44, 85, 232, .3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .15) }
.btn .kbd { margin-left: 4px }
